 Four more die of dengue, 1,512 get hospitalised
 Published : 23 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 23 October 2026, 05:49
 • 
 HEALTHCARE
 SHARE 
 Staff Correspondent 
 At least four people died of dengue and 1,512 others were hospitalised with the viral disease in the 24 hours until 8:00am yesterday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services.
 Of the four deaths, two were reported in Mymensingh division and one each in DNCC and DSCC.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities and cases, the country’s dengue death toll has risen to 368, while the total number of cases has reached 118,502.
 Currently, 6,023 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
